WordPress to Shopify Migration for The Vitamins Shoppe
The Vitamin Shoppe is a healthcare products retailer that was previously using WordPress. After discussing their needs with our Shopify developers, they decided to migrate from WordPress to Shopify with a customized premium theme. Our Shopify designers and Shopify developers took every measure to ensure their online content (which is 10+ years old) didn’t suffer an SEO meltdown in the migration.
